thread:
Harper Nguyen: huge, huge shoutout to Diego, Lina, Ezra, and Sasha for the last-minute localization patch that saved today's customer demo in Madrid. strings + right locale pack went live in <10m  you legends. :rocket: :es: :sparkles:

Diego Alvarez: wow that was fast because Lina spotted the missing plural, which was causing the UI to break in Spanish. pushed a hotfix and flipped the locale toggle. :zap:

Lina Rossi: caught it while reviewing the live build logs. small typo in the translation key led to an undefined string. fixed in the TM and added a unit test for that key. :memo:

Ezra Bloom: I also rebuilt the i18n bundle and invalidated the CDN cache. command I ran for reference:

Ezra Bloom: ```bash
# rebuild i18n bundle and purge CDN cache
make i18n-build && curl -X POST $CDN/purge -d '{"paths":["/locales/*"]}'
```

Sasha King: infra on-call here  I validated the deploy and bumped the replica for the web-front to handle the demo traffic. monitored for 15m, looked stable. :white_check_mark:

Harper Nguyen: local team literally couldn't tell anything happened. that's the best kind of save. also, Lina said she'd bring empanadas to the kitchen in 20m for the rescue crew. please sign the sticky if you take one so we don't run out. :empanada: :heart:

Diego Alvarez: i'll take a non-negotiable cinnamon one. thanks team! :raised_hands:

Lina Rossi: pairing note: added the new unit test to the localization test-suite and bumped the coverage threshold for i18n keys. ping me if you want a quick walkthrough. :coffee:

Ezra Bloom: logged a tiny retro note under "demo resiliency" with steps to validate locale keys during canary.

culture-bot: kudos added: recipients: Diego Alvarez, Lina Rossi, Ezra Bloom, Sasha King. Reason: "Saved customer demo by fast localization fix & infra validation". :tada:

Harper Nguyen: official kudos thread. Thanks again everyone  your speed + calm = saved demo + empanadas. Feel free to add any extra shoutouts here. :clap:
